text_block_list.name: Male Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Next in the Heartfire Ceremony will be the
climactic Procession race,
starting
momentarily.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Might as well say this now—Inari, I owe ya
one. If you didn't talk some
sense into me
that one time,
I wouldn't be standin' here.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it. I just wanted to make
sure the ceremony packed a
punch. If you
wanna thank me, then show me a run full
of class!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're on! Just to be clear,
I'm winnin' this thing. 'Cause today, I'm
runnin' with the
prayers of folks hungry for a win at my
back!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh. And I got the prayers of folks
wantin' to make a name for
themselves. So as their
Bearer, I'm gonna get 'em a win, and make 
sure everyone knows who I am!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be a Bearer for all the
Umamusume who ran to answer the
cheers
of their supporters.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll carry their will and their prayers
forward into the future! So Tama,
Inari...
this one's mine.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now things are really startin' to heat up.
All right, let's get started.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hark, hark! Flames, guests, Goddesses!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Tonight, hark and bear witness.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As we carry the Heartfire hence, and bear
it thither.

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text:
Dreams entwined, now joined in
procession!

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: HAAAAHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Male Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The intensity is incredible!
They're putting
up a fight worthy of an
actual race, and
the crowd is loving every second of it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Are you all watchin' from up there?
Watch me! Watch us!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(We'll carry on your prayers in the
present,
connect your dreams to
the future—this is
who we are!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(You won't have run in vain! You won't be
forgotten! Your time on the track, your
dreams, they led to this moment and we'll
scream that
truth out loud!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Not with words,
but with our runnin'! We'll
prove that you left your
footprints on this
world!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(So many have run before us! And even
more will follow after! As long
as we're
here running... as long as there are
Umamusume running!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: UOOOOOOGH!

text_block_list.name: Male Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The finish line is coming up fast! Which
Bearer will reach the bottom
and finish the
Procession first?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The ceremony was amazing. I'm so glad we
came... And is it just me,
or does
something feel almost magical?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, I feel it too.
Something in my chest...
like a flame. Guess I gotta
run it off at
training tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
So you know my next race? Yeah, I'm so
gonna win it.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you too? I was just thinking the
same thing! I wanna take off
running right
now!

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Girls, you performed your duties as
Heartfire Bearers splendidly. And
for that,
I thank you.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Entwinement, Procession—it is a
never-ending cycle. I pray that the
joy you
have given me one day finds its way back
to you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. Here's to our successful Heartfire
Ceremony!

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, for a time I thought we were done
for, so boy does it feel
good to be
celebratin'. Good work, team! And thank
you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It was tough,
but I had a fun time. I'm glad
we all got to be Bearers
together.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We learned a lotta important stuff—and
received somethin' even more important. I
still feel like I got that flame burnin' in
me, right
here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The heat of that flame will have reached
the others watching. And
now... it will
spark new dreams in them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
We have our own dreams to pursue, and
dreams we've yet to find.
And one day,
others will come to carry them on for us.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well,
when you put it like that... makes ya
feel a little brave, don't it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Every time we run, we're drawing
connections. Between the past, the

present, and the future.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of future we'll find...
Can't wait to find out.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yep. But y'know...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We still got a whole lotta present to get
through. Don'tcha think it's a
bit early to
be dreamin' about the future?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hah, you said it! If we wanna greet the
future with a bang, we can't be
snoozin'
through the here and now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I never intended to.
I shall illuminate
our present with all that I
am.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And I will join you, as we are fated to
share the same moment on the
track. We
will leave our mark, so all can see where
we ran.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
We'll keep running.
As far as our legs will
carry us, to the ends of the
earth.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Because that's what it means to be an
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text:
Forth, forth, Umamusume! Run hence, run
thither, carry far our
dreams.
